metadata.title: On weakly m-convex sets, m=1,...,n-1, in n-dimensional Euclidean spaces
metadata.abstract: We study general topological properties of open and closed weakly $m$-convex sets, $m=1,\ldots, n-1$, in the real $n$-dimensional Euclidean space $\mathbb{R}^n$, $n\geqslant2$. An open set in $\mathbb{R}^n$ is called weakly $m$-convex if, through every boundary point of the set, there passes an $m$-dimensional plane that does not intersect the set. A closed set in $\mathbb{R}^n$ is weakly $m$-convex if it can be approximated from the outside by a countably decreasing family of open weakly $m$-convex sets. The set of all points in the complement of a given subset of $\mathbb{R}^n$ through each of which every $m$-dimensional plane intersects the subset is called the $m$-nonconvexity-point set corresponding to the given subset. We prove that the nonempty $m$-nonconvexity-point set corresponding to an open weakly $m$-convex set is itself open and weakly $m$-convex, and that the interior of every closed weakly $m$-convex set with nonempty interior is weakly $m$-convex for every $m=1,\ldots, n-1$.

analysis.progressType: 弱 m 凸集合的非凸点集与取内部性质
analysis.workSummary: 在 ℝⁿ（n≥2）及 1≤m≤n−1 中，开集的弱 m 凸性指每个边界点通过一条与集合不相交的 m 维仿射平面。补集中每条过该点的 m 维平面均交原集的点称为 m 非凸点。若开弱 m 凸集的 m 非凸点集非空，则该点集开且弱 m 凸。
analysis.breakthrough: 证明由外部递减开弱 m 凸族逼近的闭弱 m 凸集，只要有非空内部，其内部也是弱 m 凸。
analysis.limitations: 非凸点集结论以开弱 m 凸原集为前提。闭集的弱 m 凸性采用指定的可数递减外逼近定义。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。核对本版本7页全文及候选元数据。标准与补充搜索均未观察到作者使用 AI 的披露。第6页 Declarations 说明研究资助、利益冲突和数据可用性。

analysis.priorityReason: 初等欧氏广义凸性的两项闭合性质。
